title: Organic treatment sheet: Preparation — Fermented extract
summary: Recipe for a concentrated fermented extract (garlic, chili pepper, ginger, alcohol, sugar) to be diluted at 1:15 to stimulate plant defenses and repel pests and diseases.

pages.title: Organic treatment: the fermented extract
pages.text:
Fermented extract is a concentrated natural preparation that strengthens plants and fights a broad spectrum of pests and diseases.

- **Total preparation time**: **11 days**.
- **Resting / fermentation time before use**: **10 days**.
pages.illustration_description: Nature morte botanique en aquarelle : gousses d'ail frais, piments rouges, racines de gingembre et un grand bocal de fermentation fermé posé sur une table rustique en bois.

pages.title: Ingredients needed
pages.text:
*(You can scale the quantities up or down according to your needs.)*

- **1 kg** of fresh garlic cloves
- **1 kg** of chili peppers
- **1 kg** of ginger
- **0.5 L** of alcohol (local or other)
- **0.5 kg** of sugar
- **3 L** of clean water
pages.illustration_description: Ingrédients disposés en aquarelle botanique : bulbes d'ail, piments rouges, rhizomes de gingembre, un bol de sucre, une bouteille d'alcool local et une cruche d'eau claire.

pages.title: Step 1: Preparing the paste
pages.text:
1. **Blend** or finely crush the garlic, chili peppers and ginger together.
2. **Add the sugar** and mix well.
3. **Then pour in the alcohol**.
4. **Mix** this paste into the **3 liters of water**.
5. **Cover** the container to start fermentation, away from direct sunlight.
pages.illustration_description: Mains ouest-africaines mélangeant une pâte dorée et rougeâtre d'ail, gingembre et piment dans un grand récipient avec de l'eau, du sucre et de l'alcool avant de le couvrir.

pages.title: Step 2: Understanding fermentation (10 days)
pages.text:
**Fermentation** is a natural process in which microorganisms (yeasts, bacteria) transform organic substances (such as sugar) into other active compounds (alcohol, acids, gases).

Fermented extract takes more time, but fermentation **further activates the bioactive compounds**.

**Over the 10 days:**
- Let it ferment for **3 days**.
- **Stir**, then let it rest for another **week** before use.
pages.illustration_description: Grand récipient couvert posé à l'ombre contenant un liquide ambré en fermentation avec de fines bulles naturelles visibles, illustrant l'activité microbienne douce.

pages.title: Step 2: Filtering and dilution (1 to 14)
pages.text:
After the 10 days of fermentation:

1. **Filter** the liquid carefully to remove solid pieces.
2. **Always dilute** before use: **1 volume of fermented extract to 14 volumes of water**.

⚠️ **Caution**: Chili pepper is a strong irritant. Protect your hands and eyes during preparation and wash your hands thoroughly after use.
pages.illustration_description: Un agriculteur ouest-africain filtrant l'extrait fermenté ambré à travers un tissu dans un petit récipient doseur, à côté d'un grand arrosoir rempli d'eau claire prêt pour la dilution.

pages.title: Step 3: Watering the bed soil
pages.text:
Once the fermented extract has been filtered and diluted (1 volume to 14 volumes of water):

- **Water the soil of the beds** with this solution, **every week or every two weeks**.

This regular application protects and stimulates your crops over the long term.
pages.illustration_description: Une agricultrice ouest-africaine marchant dans le passe-pied et arrosant doucement le sol d'une planche permanente en pleine terre paillée autour des pieds de légumes avec un arrosoir.

pages.title: Effects of the fermented extract
pages.text:
This natural preparation combines five complementary effects:

- **Insect repellent**: keeps harmful insects away (aphids, whiteflies, caterpillars, etc.).
- **Antifungal**: fights fungi (downy mildew, powdery mildew, rust, etc.).
- **Bactericidal**: acts against certain plant-pathogenic bacteria.
- **General repellent**: drives away various pests (insects and small animals).
- **Stimulant**: strengthens the plants' natural defenses.

A natural, powerful and economical solution!
pages.illustration_description: Planches permanentes en pleine terre paillée couvertes de cultures maraîchères vigoureuses et résistantes dans un jardin agroécologique ouest-africain baigné de lumière chaude.
